newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ABS changes Australia wages data sample.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ABS changes Australia wages data sample.

text.p: The Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) said changes to the sample used in compiling its average weekly earnings release and inclusion of some enterprise bargaining agreements may have affected the quarterly data announced on Thursday.

A more efficient selection of businesses had resulted in a higher than usual proportion of new business in the survey, which may increase the quarterly change standard errors for all earnings categories, the ABS said.
"Approximately 30 percent of the survey units in August 1996 were new to the survey compared with the usual proportion of about 10 percent," the ABS said.
While they were mainly smaller units, "they could have had an effect on the estimates of quarterly change," it said.
"Also a number of new enterprise bargaining agreements include some absorption of overtime earnings into ordinary time earnings," the ABS said.
"This can affect movements in the average weekly ordinary time earnings series," the bureau said.
